locationComparison.name: Morytania Spider Cave
notes: The main chamber mixes level 96 and level 146 araxytes.
Three on-task caves are east of the main chamber: north is single-way with level 146 araxytes, east is multi-way with level 96 araxytes, and south is multi-way with level 146 araxytes.

taskNotes: Araxytes require 92 Slayer to harm and Priest in Peril to be assigned directly by Nieve or Duradel.
Turael/Aya and Spria can assign Araxytes indirectly as a spiders task.
Araxytes are found exclusively in the Morytania Spider Cave.
Araxytes attack with melee and can inflict venom starting at 6 damage.
Bring venom immunity to all encounters, preferably extended anti-venom+ for long trips.
A spider cave teleport brings players to the cave entrance, but the cave is still far from a bank.
Avoid killing level 96 araxytes during normal tasks because their drop table is worse and they cannot spawn Dreadborn Araxytes.
Level 146 araxytes should be used for normal tasks because they can spawn the superior.
Dreadborn Araxyte is the superior and can only spawn from level 146 araxytes.
Normal Araxyte tasks are profitable due to stackable and alchemy drops.
Use a seed box and herb sack to reduce banking.
Picking up Araxyte venom sacks is especially valuable.
A dwarf multicannon can be used throughout the cave and kills araxytes quickly in multicombat areas.
Combine cannon with Venator bow because the larger level 146 araxytes have 2x2 hitboxes, making barrages less useful.
Barrages can be used on 1x1 level 96 araxytes, but they should generally be avoided.
Bracelets of slaughter can extend profitable tasks.
Araxxor can be killed as part of an Araxyte task for more profit at much slower task completion; a strong crush weapon is highly recommended for Araxxor.
recommendedMethod: Use level 146 araxytes, avoid level 96 araxytes, bring extended anti-venom+, seed box, herb sack, and bracelets of slaughter. Cannon plus Venator bow is the main fast normal-task method in multicombat areas. Kill Araxxor instead only when choosing profit over task speed and bring a strong crush weapon.
